items.title: Hiện tại hoàn thành tiếp diễn
form: have / has + been + V-ing: I have been waiting for an hour.
for + khoảng thời gian; since + mốc: since 8 o'clock.
use: Việc bắt đầu trong quá khứ, kéo dài tới giờ (nhấn mạnh quá trình): She has been studying all day.
Việc vừa dừng, còn dấu vết: I'm tired because I've been running.
items.note: Người Việt hay dùng hiện tại tiếp diễn: “I am waiting for an hour” là sai.
ex: I've been learning English for two years.
Tôi học tiếng Anh được hai năm rồi.
It has been raining since morning.
Trời mưa từ sáng tới giờ.
Why are you wet? Have you been swimming?
Sao bạn ướt thế? Bạn vừa bơi à?

learn.s: We ___ for the bus for twenty minutes.

why.are waiting: Có “for twenty minutes” tới giờ: hiện tại hoàn thành tiếp diễn.
why.wait: Hiện tại đơn không nói việc kéo dài tới giờ.

learn.s: She has been working here ___ 2019.

why.for: for + khoảng thời gian (for six years).
why.from: Với thì hoàn thành dùng since + mốc.

learn.s: Your eyes are red. ___ you been crying?

why.Are: Cấu trúc là have been + V-ing.
why.Did: Did không đi với been crying.

test.s: How long ___ you been living in Hanoi?

why.are: How long + have you been + V-ing.

test.s: He's tired because he ___ all morning.

why.is cleaning: Việc kéo dài cả buổi sáng tới giờ, để lại kết quả: has been cleaning.
why.cleans: Hiện tại đơn là thói quen.

learn.s: I ___ (study) for three hours. I need a break.
It ___ (snow) since yesterday.

test.s: They ___ (play) tennis since 9 a.m.
She ___ (work) here for ten years.

learn.bad: I am living here for five years.
learn.good: I have been living here for five years.
learn.why: Kéo dài tới giờ + for: have been living.
alt: I've been living here for five years.
I have lived here for five years.
I've lived here for five years.

learn.bad: She has been working here since six years.
learn.good: She has been working here for six years.
learn.why: six years là khoảng thời gian: for.

test.bad: How long are you waiting?
test.good: How long have you been waiting?
test.why: Hỏi kéo dài tới giờ: have you been waiting.

test.bad: It is raining since this morning.
test.good: It has been raining since this morning.
alt: It's been raining since this morning.

items.title: Quá khứ hoàn thành
form: had + V3: When I arrived, the film had started.
Phủ định: hadn't + V3. Hỏi: Had you + V3…?
use: Việc xảy ra TRƯỚC một việc khác trong quá khứ.
items.note: Không dùng quá khứ hoàn thành khi hai việc nối tiếp bình thường: “I got up and had breakfast” là đúng.
ex: When we got to the station, the train had left.
Khi chúng tôi tới ga thì tàu đã chạy rồi.
I had never seen the sea before I was ten.
Trước năm mười tuổi tôi chưa từng thấy biển.
She was sad because she had lost her keys.
Cô ấy buồn vì đã làm mất chìa khoá.

learn.s: When I got home, my sister ___ dinner.

why.has already cooked: Mốc là quá khứ (got home): dùng had.
why.already cooks: Việc xảy ra trước một việc quá khứ: had + V3.

learn.s: He couldn't pay because he ___ his wallet at home.

why.has left: Câu ở quá khứ: had left.
why.leaves: Việc để quên xảy ra trước: had left.

learn.s: I ___ never flown before that trip.

why.have: “before that trip” là quá khứ: had.

test.s: By the time the police arrived, the thief ___.

why.has escaped: By the time + quá khứ: had escaped.
why.escapes: Việc xảy ra trước: had + V3.

test.s: She told me she ___ the book already.

why.has read: Sau “told” (quá khứ) lùi về had read.
why.reads: Việc đọc xảy ra trước lúc nói: had read.

learn.s: When we arrived, the concert ___ (begin).
I was hungry because I ___ (not eat) all day.

test.s: After she ___ (finish) her homework, she went out.
They ___ (never / see) snow before.

learn.bad: When I arrived, the film has started.
learn.good: When I arrived, the film had started.
learn.why: Mốc quá khứ: had started.
alt: When I arrived, the film had already started.

learn.bad: She had went home before I called.
learn.good: She had gone home before I called.
learn.why: had + V3: gone, không phải went.

test.bad: I didn't know him because I have never met him before.
test.good: I didn't know him because I had never met him before.
test.why: Câu ở quá khứ: had never met.

test.bad: By the time we got there, everyone left.
test.good: By the time we got there, everyone had left.
test.why: By the time + quá khứ: việc trước dùng had left.
alt: By the time we got there, everyone had already left.

items.title: Used to / would: thói quen trong quá khứ
items.en: Used to and would for past habits
form: used to + V: I used to play football.
didn't use to + V; Did you use to + V?
would + V (chỉ việc lặp lại, không dùng cho trạng thái).
use: Việc hay làm / trạng thái trước đây, bây giờ không còn.
items.note: Phân biệt: used to + V (trước đây hay) và be used to + V-ing (quen với). Không nói “I would have long hair” (trạng thái): dùng used to.
ex: I used to live in Da Nang.
Tôi từng sống ở Đà Nẵng.
We didn't use to have a car.
Trước đây nhà tôi không có ô tô.
Every summer my grandad would take us fishing.
Mùa hè nào ông cũng dẫn chúng tôi đi câu cá.

learn.s: I ___ smoke, but I stopped last year.

why.use to: Câu khẳng định dùng used to.
why.was used to: be used to + V-ing là “quen với”.

learn.s: Did you ___ walk to school?

why.used to: Sau did dùng use to (không có d).
why.using to: Cấu trúc: Did you use to + V?

learn.s: She ___ have long hair when she was young.

why.would: have long hair là trạng thái: không dùng would.
why.is used to: is used to + V-ing là quen với.

test.s: There ___ be a cinema here, but now it's a bank.

why.would: Trạng thái (there be): dùng used to.
why.was used to: was used to = đã quen với.

test.s: My father ___ get up early. Now he sleeps late.

why.is used to: is used to = quen với, đi với V-ing.

learn.s: I ___ (be) very shy as a child.
We ___ (not / have) the internet at home.

test.s: My mum ___ (cook) pho every Sunday.
___ you ___ (play) games a lot? (Did … ?)

learn.bad: I use to live in Hue.
learn.good: I used to live in Hue.
learn.why: Khẳng định: used to.

learn.bad: Did you used to work there?
learn.good: Did you use to work there?
learn.why: Sau did: use to.

test.bad: He didn't used to like coffee.
test.good: He didn't use to like coffee.

test.bad: I would have a dog when I was small.
test.good: I used to have a dog when I was small.
test.why: have (sở hữu) là trạng thái: used to.

items.title: Câu điều kiện loại 2
form: If + quá khứ đơn, would / could + V: If I had more time, I would travel.
If I were you, I would… (lời khuyên).
use: Điều không có thật / khó xảy ra ở hiện tại, tương lai.
items.note: Không dùng would trong vế if: “If I would have money” là sai.
ex: If I won the lottery, I would buy a house.
Nếu tôi trúng số, tôi sẽ mua nhà.
If I were you, I'd see a doctor.
Nếu tôi là bạn, tôi sẽ đi khám.
She could get the job if she spoke English.
Cô ấy có thể được nhận nếu nói được tiếng Anh.

learn.s: If I ___ rich, I would help poor people.

why.am: Điều không thật ở hiện tại: lùi về were.

learn.s: If she had a car, she ___ drive to work.
What would you do if you ___ a lion?

why.see: Giả định: quá khứ đơn saw.

test.s: If I ___ you, I would apologise.
We ___ go out if it wasn't raining.

learn.s: If I ___ (have) wings, I would fly.
If he studied harder, he ___ (pass) the exam.

test.s: If we ___ (live) by the sea, we would swim every day.
I ___ (buy) that phone if it were cheaper.

learn.bad: If I would have time, I would help you.
learn.good: If I had time, I would help you.
learn.why: Vế if dùng quá khứ đơn.
alt: If I had time, I'd help you.

learn.bad: If I was rich, I will buy a car.
learn.good: If I was rich, I would buy a car.
learn.why: Loại 2: would.
alt: If I were rich, I would buy a car.
If I were rich, I'd buy a car.
If I was rich, I'd buy a car.

test.bad: If I am you, I would call her.
test.good: If I were you, I would call her.
test.why: Giả định: If I were you.
alt: If I were you, I'd call her.

test.bad: She would come if she has time.
test.good: She would come if she had time.
alt: She'd come if she had time.

items.title: Bị động các thì khác
form: Hoàn thành: has / have been + V3.
Tương lai: will be + V3.
Đang: is / are being + V3.
Sau động từ khuyết thiếu: can / must / should be + V3.
use: Nhấn vào việc / đồ vật, không vào người làm.
items.note: Hay quên be: “The road will built” sai; “will be built” đúng.
ex: The bridge has been repaired.
Cây cầu đã được sửa.
The results will be announced tomorrow.
Ngày mai kết quả sẽ được công bố.
Phones must be switched off.
Điện thoại phải được tắt.

learn.s: A new school ___ next year.

why.will build: Trường không tự xây: bị động will be built.

learn.s: My car ___ at the moment.

why.is repairing: Xe không tự sửa: is being repaired.

learn.s: This film ___ seen by millions of people.

why.has: Bị động cần been: has been seen.

test.s: The homework must ___ by Friday.

why.finish: Bài không tự làm: must be finished.

test.s: Two people ___ in the accident.

why.have injured: Người bị thương: bị động have been injured.
why.has injured: people số nhiều và cần bị động.

learn.s: The letter ___ (will / send) tomorrow.
The house ___ (has / sell).

test.s: This room ___ (must / clean) every day.
The road ___ (is / repair) now. (đang)

learn.bad: The meeting will held on Monday.
learn.good: The meeting will be held on Monday.
learn.why: Bị động tương lai: will be + V3.

learn.bad: My bike has stolen.
learn.good: My bike has been stolen.
learn.why: Bị động hoàn thành: has been + V3.

test.bad: Smoking should be not allowed.
test.good: Smoking should not be allowed.
alt: Smoking shouldn't be allowed.

test.bad: The bridge is building now.
test.good: The bridge is being built now.
test.why: Cầu được xây: is being built.

items.title: Câu tường thuật: say / tell, lùi thì
form: say (that) + mệnh đề; tell + người + (that) + mệnh đề.
Lùi thì: am / is → was; will → would; can → could; hiện tại hoàn thành → had + V3.
Đổi: today → that day, tomorrow → the next day, here → there.
items.note: Không nói “He said me”; phải là “He told me” hoặc “He said to me”.
ex: “I'm tired.” → She said she was tired.
Cô ấy nói cô ấy mệt.
“I will call you.” → He told me he would call me.
Anh ấy bảo sẽ gọi cho tôi.
“We can't come.” → They said they couldn't come.
Họ nói họ không đến được.

learn.s: She ___ me that she was hungry.

why.said: say không có người ngay sau: said (to me).
why.spoke: spoke không dùng để thuật lời.

learn.s: “I live in Hue.” → He said he ___ in Hue.

why.will live: Không đổi nghĩa sang tương lai.

learn.s: “I will help.” → She said she ___ help.

test.s: Tom ___ that he had finished.

why.told: told cần người phía sau (told me).

test.s: “I can swim.” → She said she ___ swim.

learn.s: “I am busy.” → He said he ___ busy.
“We have finished.” → They said they ___ (finish).

test.s: “I will come.” → She said she ___ come.
“I don't like fish.” → He said he ___ fish.

learn.bad: He said me that he was sick.
learn.good: He told me that he was sick.
learn.why: say không có người ngay sau; dùng tell + người.
alt: He told me he was sick.
He said to me that he was sick.

learn.bad: She said she will come.
learn.good: She said she would come.
learn.why: Lùi thì: will → would.

test.bad: They told that they were late.
test.good: They said that they were late.
test.why: tell cần người phía sau; không có người thì dùng said.
alt: They said they were late.
They told me that they were late.

test.bad: He said he can drive.
test.good: He said he could drive.

items.title: Câu hỏi tường thuật
form: Có từ hỏi: asked + từ hỏi + chủ ngữ + động từ: She asked where I lived.
Có / không: asked if / whether + chủ ngữ + động từ.
use: Kể lại câu hỏi của người khác; hỏi lịch sự.
items.note: Không đảo ngữ, không dùng do / does / did: “She asked where did I live” là sai.
ex: “Where do you work?” → He asked where I worked.
Anh ấy hỏi tôi làm ở đâu.
“Are you hungry?” → Mum asked if I was hungry.
Mẹ hỏi tôi có đói không.
“What time is it?” → She asked what time it was.
Cô ấy hỏi mấy giờ rồi.

learn.s: He asked me where ___.

why.did I live: Câu hỏi tường thuật không dùng did, không đảo.
why.do I live: Không đảo, lùi thì: I lived.

learn.s: She asked ___ I liked coffee.

why.that: Câu hỏi có / không: if / whether.

learn.s: They asked what time the shop ___.

why.did open: Không dùng trợ động từ trong câu hỏi tường thuật.
why.does open: Lùi thì và không dùng does.

test.s: The teacher asked why ___ late.
He asked ___ I could help him.

why.that: Câu hỏi có / không: whether / if.

learn.s: “Do you speak French?” → She asked ___ I spoke French.
“Where is the bank?” → He asked where the bank ___.

test.s: “How old are you?” → She asked how old I ___.
“Can you swim?” → He asked if I ___ swim.

learn.bad: She asked where did I go.
learn.good: She asked where I went.
learn.why: Không dùng did, không đảo.
alt: She asked where I had gone.

learn.bad: He asked me that I was tired.
learn.good: He asked me if I was tired.
learn.why: Câu hỏi có / không: if / whether.
alt: He asked me whether I was tired.
He asked if I was tired.

test.bad: They asked what was my name.
test.good: They asked what my name was.

test.bad: I asked her where does she live.
test.good: I asked her where she lived.

items.title: Mệnh đề quan hệ không xác định
form: Danh từ đã rõ, + who / which / where …, : My brother, who lives in Hue, is a doctor.
Có dấu phẩy; không dùng that; không bỏ được who / which.
use: Thêm thông tin phụ về người / vật đã rõ là ai, cái gì.
items.note: Không dùng that sau dấu phẩy: “Hanoi, that is the capital” là sai.
ex: My mother, who is 60, still works.
Mẹ tôi, năm nay 60 tuổi, vẫn đi làm.
Ha Long Bay, which is in Quang Ninh, is famous.
Vịnh Hạ Long, ở Quảng Ninh, rất nổi tiếng.
We visited Hoi An, where my parents met.
Chúng tôi đến Hội An, nơi bố mẹ tôi gặp nhau.

learn.s: My boss, ___ is very kind, gave me a day off.

why.that: Sau dấu phẩy không dùng that.

learn.s: Hanoi, ___ is the capital, has many lakes.

why.that: Sau dấu phẩy không dùng that.

learn.s: I stayed in Dalat, ___ it was cool.

why.which: Cần chỉ nơi cho “it was cool”: where.
why.that: Không dùng that sau dấu phẩy.

test.s: My car, ___ is ten years old, still runs well.

why.that: Sau dấu phẩy không dùng that.

test.s: Mr Nam, ___ son is my friend, is a pilot.

why.who: Sở hữu (con của ông ấy): whose.

learn.s: My sister, ___ lives in Paris, is a chef. (người)
This phone, ___ I bought last year, is broken. (vật)

test.s: Da Nang, ___ I grew up, is by the sea. (nơi)
Lan, ___ father is a doctor, wants to be a nurse. (sở hữu)

learn.bad: My father, that is a teacher, loves books.
learn.good: My father, who is a teacher, loves books.
learn.why: Sau dấu phẩy không dùng that.

learn.bad: Hue, which I was born, is beautiful.
learn.good: Hue, where I was born, is beautiful.
learn.why: Chỉ nơi: where.
alt: Hue, in which I was born, is beautiful.

test.bad: My laptop, that I use every day, is old.
test.good: My laptop, which I use every day, is old.

test.bad: Linh, who her brother is my friend, is nice.
test.good: Linh, whose brother is my friend, is nice.

items.title: Suy đoán hiện tại: must / might / can't
form: must + V: chắc chắn đúng.
might / may / could + V: có thể.
can't + V: chắc chắn không.
items.note: Trái nghĩa của must (chắc chắn) là can't, không phải mustn't (mustn't = cấm).
ex: The lights are on. They must be at home.
Đèn sáng. Chắc họ ở nhà.
She isn't answering. She might be asleep.
Cô ấy không nghe máy. Có thể cô ấy đang ngủ.
He can't be hungry. He's just eaten.
Anh ấy không thể đói. Anh ấy vừa ăn xong.

learn.s: You've worked all day. You ___ be tired.

why.can't: Dấu hiệu cho thấy chắc chắn mệt: must.
why.mustn't: mustn't là cấm, không phải đoán.

learn.s: That ___ be Tom. He's in London now.

why.must: Tom đang ở London nên chắc chắn không phải: can't.

learn.s: I'm not sure where she is. She ___ be at work.

test.s: He has three cars. He ___ be rich.
This ___ be the right road. It's a dead end.

why.must: Đường cụt: chắc chắn không đúng.

learn.s: She's smiling. She ___ be happy. (chắc chắn)
That ___ be true! It's impossible. (chắc chắn không)

test.s: Take an umbrella. It ___ rain later. (có thể)
They ___ be at home. The car isn't there. (chắc chắn không)

learn.bad: He mustn't be at home. His car is gone.
learn.good: He can't be at home. His car is gone.
learn.why: Đoán chắc chắn không: can't.
alt: He cannot be at home. His car is gone.

learn.bad: She must to be tired.
learn.good: She must be tired.
learn.why: Sau must không có to.

test.bad: It can be Lan. She's in Japan.
test.good: It can't be Lan. She's in Japan.
alt: It cannot be Lan. She's in Japan.

test.bad: They might are busy.
test.good: They might be busy.
test.why: Sau might dùng V nguyên mẫu: be.

items.title: Câu hỏi đuôi
form: Câu khẳng định → đuôi phủ định: It's hot, isn't it?
Câu phủ định → đuôi khẳng định: You don't smoke, do you?
Đuôi dùng trợ động từ của câu; I am → aren't I?
use: Xác nhận điều mình nghĩ, mời người kia đồng ý.
items.note: Hay sai trợ động từ: “You like tea, isn't it?” sai; phải là “don't you?”.
ex: You're Vietnamese, aren't you?
Bạn là người Việt, phải không?
She can swim, can't she?
Cô ấy biết bơi, đúng không?
They didn't come, did they?
Họ không đến, phải không?

learn.s: You like music, ___?

why.isn't it: Câu dùng like: trợ động từ do.
why.do you: Câu khẳng định: đuôi phủ định.

learn.s: He can't drive, ___?

why.can't he: Câu phủ định: đuôi khẳng định.
why.does he: Trợ động từ của câu là can.

learn.s: It was a great film, ___?

test.s: They have finished, ___?

why.didn't they: Câu dùng have + V3: haven't they.

test.s: I'm late, ___?

why.am not I: Đuôi của I am là aren't I.
why.isn't I: Đuôi của I am là aren't I.

learn.s: She works here, ___ she?
You aren't busy, ___ you?

test.s: We will win, ___ we?
He didn't call, ___ he?

learn.bad: You speak English, isn't it?
learn.good: You speak English, don't you?
learn.why: Trợ động từ của speak là do.

learn.bad: She is nice, is she?
learn.good: She is nice, isn't she?
learn.why: Câu khẳng định: đuôi phủ định.

test.bad: They went home, don't they?
test.good: They went home, didn't they?

test.bad: You can't come, can't you?
test.good: You can't come, can you?
test.why: Câu phủ định: đuôi khẳng định.

items.title: So / such … that; too / enough + to V
form: so + tính từ / trạng từ + that: It was so hot that we stayed in.
such (a / an) + (tính từ) + danh từ + that: It was such a hot day that…
too + tính từ + to V; tính từ + enough + to V; enough + danh từ.
items.note: enough đứng SAU tính từ: “old enough”, không nói “enough old”.
ex: The film was so boring that I fell asleep.
Phim chán đến mức tôi ngủ gật.
It was such a nice day that we went to the beach.
Hôm đó đẹp trời đến mức chúng tôi đi biển.
He isn't old enough to drive.
Cậu ấy chưa đủ tuổi lái xe.

why.too: too đi với to V, không đi với that.

items.title: Động từ + to V hay V-ing đổi nghĩa
items.en: Verbs with -ing or to + infinitive: change in meaning
form: stop + V-ing: thôi làm; stop + to V: dừng lại để làm.
remember / forget + V-ing: nhớ / quên việc đã làm; + to V: nhớ / quên việc phải làm.
try + V-ing: thử; try + to V: cố gắng.
use: Chọn đúng dạng để đúng nghĩa.
items.note: “I stopped to smoke” = dừng lại để hút thuốc, ngược hẳn với “I stopped smoking” = bỏ thuốc.
ex: He stopped smoking last year.
Anh ấy bỏ thuốc năm ngoái.
Remember to lock the door.
Nhớ khoá cửa nhé.
I'll never forget meeting you.
Tôi sẽ không bao giờ quên lần gặp bạn.

items.title: Although / despite / in spite of
items.en: Contrast: although, despite, in spite of
form: although / even though + mệnh đề: Although it rained, we went out.
despite / in spite of + danh từ / V-ing: Despite the rain, we went out.
despite the fact that + mệnh đề.
items.note: Không dùng “although … but” trong một câu (tiếng Việt nói “tuy … nhưng”).
ex: Although he was tired, he kept working.
Dù mệt, anh ấy vẫn làm tiếp.
Despite the traffic, we arrived on time.
Dù kẹt xe, chúng tôi vẫn tới đúng giờ.
In spite of being ill, she went to school.
Dù ốm, cô ấy vẫn đi học.
